Alphabet’s revenue grew from $282,836M in FY2022 to $350,018M in FY2024.[DOC-1]  
Meta’s revenue grew from $116,609M in FY2022 to $164,501M in FY2024.[DOC-1]

Both companies are on the same fiscal year basis, and the periods (FY2022 to FY2024) are directly comparable based on the excerpts provided.

Alphabet revenue growth 2022–2024:  
(350,018 − 282,836) / 282,836 ≈ 0.2378 → about 23.8%

Meta revenue growth 2022–2024:  
(164,501 − 116,609) / 116,609 ≈ 0.4109 → about 41.1%

Difference in cumulative growth:  
41.1% − 23.8% ≈ 17.3 percentage points.

ANSWER: Meta, by roughly 17 percentage points
